agent.problem: Discovery guesses dominate this stop. Card 2 asks for wine with no clue, card 6 asks whether the Rechabites drink before their command is known, card 7 introduces Jonadab only in the answers, and card 10 asks for Jonadab's reason without context. That is four of the stop's seven choice cards, so most are not informed guesses a baker can reason out from the earlier cards.

rule.text: A few discovery questions are fine. Some moments can't be reasoned out, like where Jonah's ship is headed. A few of those are okay, as long as most choice cards are informed guesses.
